map.弦长小于弧长。: Chord length is shorter than arc length.
map.由半径与转角算曲线弦长。: Compute the curve chord length from radius and deflection angle.
map.放样弦线替代量弧长。: Use a chord line for staking instead of measuring arc length.
map.道路曲线要素之一。: One of the road curve elements.
map.半径 R=200m、转角 Δ=60° → 弦长 C=2R·sin(Δ/2)=2×: Radius R=200 m, deflection Δ=60° → chord C = 2R·sin(Δ/2) = 2×200×sin30° = 200 m.
map.现场不便量弧，用弦长 200m 两端拉线标定弦，再细分测点逼近曲线。: When arc length is hard to measure on site, set the chord of 200 m by stretching a line between its ends, then subdivide points to approach the curve.
map.弦长和弧长区别？: What is the difference between chord and arc length?
map.弦是两端直线、弧是曲线；Δ 小两者近，Δ 大差异显，放样用弦更可控。: The chord is the straight line between ends, the arc is curved; for small Δ they are close, for large Δ the gap is obvious, and the chord is more controllable for staking.
map.（半径 R、圆心角 Δ）分半得 C/2=R sin(Δ/2)。: (radius R, central angle Δ) halved gives C/2 = R sin(Δ/2).
